Bring a friend: a member's invite link (/f/CODE) where the friend leaves name and number for the gym to call
Become a member online (/m/CODE): see the gym's plans and prices, verify the mobile number, pick a plan or free trial and send details to the gym
switch: gym's own 'not taking sign-ups online' setting (name unknown; worker.js:296 g.closed)

name: Pay online on the join page: is online pay offered, pay through the gym's own payment company, check it, or say 'I have paid' for a UPI payment
switch: JOIN_PAY (off); the owner's 'Take payments when people join online' switch

name: A gym's own free web page (join.mettleup.fit/<gym>): plans, timings, address and maps links, facilities, photos, WhatsApp share, Become a member button
Ask the gym a question, or report a page, from the gym's web page
AI helper chat on the gym's web page: answers from the page only, else 'I will ask the gym'; the visitor can leave a number for a call or to join
Tell the admin app which built features are switched on (/api/switches) and where invite and join links point (/api/links)
Send feedback from the member app or the admin app
Help and feedback with an AI answer from the help articles (or matching help pages when no AI is asked), 'Did this solve it?', and reading the team's reply
AI answers for members and page visitors are taken from the gym's AI credits (owner's and staff's own questions are free, with a daily limit)
switch: AI_CREDITS_CHARGE (on); the owner's AI on/off and monthly limit

name: Speak your feedback: the member app's voice clip is turned into text to check and send
Crash reports from both apps, kept 90 days
MettleUp news in the admin app's notification bell (what HQ sent to every gym)
AI matches the columns of a gym's member file during import (with a per-gym limit)
AI Assistant for the gym owner: ask in words or by voice, get answers from reports, a message rewritten, or the right admin page opened (the catalogue of pages it may open)
AI writes a workout plan for a member from the gym's own exercise list (3 credits on Save)
Online payments: the owner connects, changes or disconnects the gym's own payment company (keys sealed), and the desk sees whether payments are on
Online payments: the desk asks a member to pay by link or QR, checks, cancels, sees who paid, claims and records the payment
Online payments: the owner's two switches (take payments in the member app; when people join online) and the list of join payments
Online payments: a member pays dues or a shop order in the member app and the app checks the payment
switch: PAY_LIVE (off: test mode); the owner's 'Take payments in the member app' switch

name: Online payments: the payment company's webhook and the 10-minute check mark open links paid
The owner buys a MettleUp plan online (the request is passed to HQ)
Browser alerts for the admin app: the public key a browser subscribes with
Sign-in code sent by WhatsApp (forgot PIN, set up a new gym): send the 6-digit code and check it; WhatsApp news about each message (delivered, failed and why) is logged
Verify with WhatsApp: the person sends a code to MettleUp's business number to prove their mobile (forgot PIN, new gym, member app, join online) and gets a reply
Block-proof server address (/sb): both apps reach the gym server through MettleUp's own address; a sent message, a new offer or an answer reaches phones at once
Install the admin app on the device and open it with no internet (service worker)
Company and legal pages: About, Contact, Privacy, Terms, Refunds, Shipping and delivery, Data agreement for gyms, Delete your account
Daily clean-up at 03:00 India: old crash reports, voice counts, sign-in codes and join-form counts are deleted
Not a feature, test tools: sqliteD1.mjs is the pretend database the Worker tests run on; razorpayTestMode.check.mjs runs the real Razorpay test API in CI
